title: The AI Household CFO
pitch: Wire ha-mcp's smart-home control into Sure's personal finance tracking so one AI assistant watches both your house and your wallet: it notices your thermostat or appliance usage is pushing the electric bill up, cross-checks it against your Sure budget, and proactively suggests (or with permission, makes) automation changes to stay under a spending target. Pitch this as a managed subscription to budget-conscious smart-home owners -- the kind of person who already has Home Assistant and already wished their energy bill talked to their budget app.
why_now: Both repos trended today, both already expose themselves to AI assistants via standard protocols, and neither currently talks to the other -- the gap is the opportunity. Energy costs and 'get my spending under control' are evergreen pains, and wiring two open-source AI-native tools together is a weekend integration, not a rebuild.
